translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Pablo, Romase barmilesad

Dummagan Italiase anmar-barmidye sogsamargu, Pablo, degi, baigan-eskaryagi-mellesimalad, Roma-sordamar-dulatar-sediid, Julio-nugadga Pablo-uksamarsunnad. A-dulede Roma-sordamar-danagwen-sediid, Augustaye-nugad e-dummad-wargwenadid.
Degi anmar bela ur-Adramitioginedgi nakwismarsunnad. A-ur deun Asia-yarse nae sognaid. Deun Aristarco anmarba gudimogad. A-dulede Tesalónica-dolad, Macedonia-yargined.
A-banedgine, Sidón-neggweburse anmar modapmalad. Julio nued Pablogi binsassoggu, Pabloga igar uksasunnad, sunna e-aimarse ataknaegar, degi, e-aimar adi sunna ega ibmar-ukmalagar.
Sidóngi anmar bangudgu, Chipre-dup-irwa anmar nasmalad, ar ade burwa anmar-asabinnid.
Agi anmar Cilicia-yar, degi, Panfilia-yar, a abin-obakar anmar nasmalad, geb degi anmar Mira-neggweburse modapmarsunnad. Mira-neggweburde Licia-yargi siid.
Roma-sordamar-dulatar-sediid Miragi ur-Alejandríagined amisad. A-ur Italiase nae-sognaisoggu, a-urgi anmar-onakwissunnad.
Degine, ibbigbasaale anmar binnaa nadap-gusad. Undar anmar imaksadgine, geb Gnido-asabin anmar modapmarsunnad. Ar burwa anmar-asabinsoggu, Salmón-dup-asabin anmar nadsunnad, Creta-dup-irwa.
Creta-gakaba beedse anmar na imaknadapmargu, ur-nagumalad, Buenos-Puertosye nugadse, anmar modapmalad. A-waliksaar Lasea-neggwebur siid.

Ar ibagan-beedsegus nadapgussoggu, anmar urgi-naed undar guarsunnad, ar ade bato mas-gunsuli-gudigued-e-ibagan nasad, degisoggu, demar-dummad-gued-e-wilubgan omossunnad. Agala Pablo dummaganga binsaed ukarsunnad,
sogdesunnad: “Aimar, andi an dakgua, anmar nasokalidi sunna anmar beedse naibi-gudago an dakdo. Anmar-ibmarbi yogguosulid, ulu, degine, anmar-san-burbase-bakar yogguer yogguodo.”
Roma-sordamar-dulatar-sediid Pablo-ega-ibmar-sogedba gwen imaksasulid, ar bur-bule ur-captan, degi, ur-ibed-ega-sogedba igar-imaksad.

Ar ur-nagued-neg nuedsursoggu, demar-dummadir, geg ur nagu-daed, degisoggu, belagwablesaar Fenicese bur nabi-guarmalad. “Fenice-neggweburdi Creta-dupgi urmar-nagued-nuegan nikad. Agi dad-nakwedsiki-baksaar, degi, yarsiki-baksaar sunna atakleged. Agi demar-dummad-berguedse nagumaloye,” sogsamalad.
Pablo nadapidgi burwa-dummad nosad
Degi, burwa-nued binnasdikii anmarga gollargu, degibi ega sadeguoye bimalansoggu, esnas ebismarsunnad, geb Creta-dup gakanaga-nagaba nadmarsunnad.
Sikwas anmar nanaedgine, anmargi burwa-dummad noalid. A-burwa Euroclidónye-nugad.
Anmar geg ur abingagussoggu, anmar-ur burwa-dummadba e-itoleged seledsunnad.
Dupu-senigwad Clauda-nugad-irwa anmar nasad, ar ade a-irwardi burwa-binnasur gormaisulid. Deginbali undar anmar imakedgine, urbode anmar ur-sorba-nai-sedanikidi, urse onakwismalad.

Urbode ur-dummadse onakwisad-sorba, anmar ur-dummad dubgi ebirmasmalad, adi ur mer marega. Abakalegi olli-Sirte-nugadgi, ur mellealirye, anmar binsaedba, anmar urmor esusmalad, adi wis binna anmar selemai-guegar.
A-banedgine amba burwa binnasur gormaisoggu, anmar-ur dogbi-gualid. A-ular anmar ibmar-semaidi demarse mie daklearsunnad.
Degi a-ibapaagwad-sorba anmar ur-ibmarse-bakar mie daklealid.
Ar burwa binnasur nomaisoggu, degi, nue neg-atimaidba ibbigbasaar dada, degi, niskwamar gwen bar daklessursoggu, anmar bar na san onogo-deeye gwen binsassurmalad.

Ar ibbigbagus mas anmar gwen gunsursoggu, Pablo emar-abargi gwisgusgu, emarga sogded: “Aimar, an-bemarga-ibmar-sogsadba bemar ib-imaksamalana, anmar Creta-dupgi noarsulindo. Agine, weyob anmar wilenaisulindo, degi, weyob anmar-ibmar yogguosurbalindo.
Ar degi-inigwele, mer bukib binsamalo, gandik na be imakmar, ar dule-wargwensaar na san-burba yogguosulid, unnila urbi yogguoed.
“Ar emi mutik Bab-Dummad-anger anse arbid. Ar an Bab Dummadgadsoggu, degi, an ega arbabarsoggu, na e-anger anga barmialid.
A-anger anga sogsad: ‘Pablo mer dobguo, ar Roma-saila-dummad-abin be gwisgunaer-gebed. Be-ulale Bab Dummad dulemar-bela-urgi-nadapmalad-abonogoed, wargwensaar dule gwen burgosulid.’
Degisoggu, an-aimar, gandik na be imakmar, ar an Bab Dummad nue bensursoggu, an wisdo, anger-anga-ibmar-sogsad-sunnaa guoed.
Ar degi-inigwele, bela anmar dupuse warmaker-gebed.”
Degine, anmar ibambe-gakabakegus gannar-gannar Adriático-demargi seledigua, nega-gabigwenadbali, selamar gaka-modaniye bimalanad.
Degisoggu, selamar dii wilub-imasmalad, wisguega, bule dii wila-dibeye. Dakargua, dali-dulagwen wirgu. Agi sikwas nadbargu, gannar wilub-imakdemarbalid, agindi dakargu, dali-ambe-gakatar wirgued.
Abakalegi akwamargi ur yolealirye anmar binsaedbali, esnas-gwabake anmar ur-sorba egwachamalad. Degine, bitigi gwae oibosana-gadinye anmar binsabukwa-guarmalad.
Degi selagan, arbak-wakinnedgi binsaarmargu, aga urbode demarse odesmalad, yamo esnas ur-asuba egwan-sokaliyob imaksamalad.
Ar Pablo Roma-sordamar-dulatar-sediidga, degi, sordamarga sogded: —We-selamar ur-yagi ambikusulile, bemar geg na san onomalad.
Degi sordamar urbode-atillenaid-e-dub siksamarsunnad. Degisoggu, urbode diiba seledsunnad.
Bolegoedbali, Pablo aimargi wilenagusad, wis mas gunmalagar. Pablo weyob sogded: —Ibambe-gakabakegus bemar gwen nue gabdisulid, degi, gwen mas gundisurbalid.
Degisoggu, bemar wis mas gunmar, ar a wis bemar-ogannogoed. Be-sailagia-gagwensaar gwen wis yogguosurmalad, bela bemar abonolegoedbimalad.
Pablo degi-sogsad-sorba, madu susad, geb bela aimar-wagab Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogsagu, madu bichisgu, geb agi madu gutesunnad.
Agine, belagwapa gwage-gangudmalad, degi, amar mas gutemarmosunnad.
Belagwapa anmar urgi-nadapidi, anmar dulataled-ilabo-gakadulapaa-gakambe-gakanergwa (276) mergumalad.
Bela nue-immeles mas-guchamalad-sorba, madubur-gwagwaled demarse mismalad, adi wis ur ukuu saegar.
Ur ukubgi melledapgu ayarided
Oibosgu, ur-selamar aku neg dakmalad bia gunanai. Degine, sukun-bipigwadgi ukub-nued nai dakarmalad. “Sunna ede ur-sedmalar, a-ukub-nued-naidse dogega demar-gakase ur sedye,” sokarmarsunnad.

Degisoggu, urdub esnasmargi-atinnanaid siksamarsunnad, degi, esnasmar diyagi mete obesmarsundo. Degi, ur-sorgaed-atinnaled e-dub siksamarsundo. Agi geb urmor-asubalid onakwismargu, ur ukub-nued-naidsik searsunnad.
Amba yo demar-gakase nue moe, ur demar-nukamaksidsik melleded, degi, ur ukubgi dingunonisunnad. E-asu ukubgi nue-dogsa megisad, e-sordi demar-nukamakedba ayarided.
Roma-sordamar dulemar-eskaryagi-mellesimalad-selemamaid oburgwemaloye sogsamalad, melle dommomakar wakinmalagar.

Ar Roma-sordamar-dulatar-sediid yapa Pablo-oburgwesoggu, sordamar dule-galebukmalad-oburgwega gwen imaksasulid. Aka bur sogded: “Dulemar-sunna-dommomakmalad-inse demarse babatoye, adi dommo-dommo demar-gakase warmakmalagar.”
Baigandi a-sorba gwen-gwen urgogi, degi, ur-goamaklesmaladgi obakdemalad. Degisoggu, belagwapa nueganbi gakase warmaksamarsundo.
